Earlier15August broker registration/marketing describes316-home broader scheme. This is the dated official collection/unveiling, not first-ever sales. Current price/availability/payment/EOI/handover unknown.
items.nextCheck: Current villa inventory and official commercial terms.

items.name: Wyndham Residences Marjan Beach / ORAYA
items.finding: ORAYA's 30 September corporate-entry press release describes its first furnished Marjan Beach residence without naming it. ORAYA's own site identifies Wyndham Residences Marjan Beach and advertises limited premium units; indexed project Instagram content dates to 10 August 2026 and a Wyndham executive publicly referenced the project before September. No distinct fresh phase, inventory, price, EOI or sales-opening event was disclosed. Do not treat the press-release date as project launch date.
items.nextCheck: Only publish a named new phase, dated fresh inventory release, or material official commercial terms.

items.name: Soma Residences
items.finding: DLD-derived first trace dates to March 2026 and dated selling material existed by 10 September. Current portal/listing activity does not establish a new phase or fresh sales event.
items.nextCheck: Only a named new phase, released inventory or material official terms qualify.

items.name: Mirasol II
items.finding: RAK Properties material confirms the scheme, but launch evidence dates to 2025. No distinct October 2026 phase or material new terms were found.
items.nextCheck: Only a documented new release or materially changed official terms qualify.

items.name: Rabdan Avenue
items.finding: Rabdan official project page confirms 147 residences in Meydan, one- to three-bedroom apartments plus 3BR duplexes, from AED 1.3m and a 40/60 plan. Dated launch coverage is 1 October 2026 and Rabdan published an official launch recap. Official page contains conflicting completion fields: Q1 2028 in progress and Q2 2029 in the payment schedule.
items.nextCheck: Developer clarification of completion date and current unit-by-unit availability.

items.name: The Yards Plaza by BEYOND
items.finding: Multiple broker pages plus Alnair briefing invitation and dated 5 October OffPlan Insider report identify 7 October commercial release; 272 shell-and-core offices. Prices/payment/EOI/handover remain broker indications.
items.nextCheck: Briefing results and developer commercial pack

items.name: KORE by Imtiaz
items.finding: Official Imtiaz LinkedIn confirms wellness concept. 1 October dated broker invitation report places reveal 8 October. Prices and three-year post-handover terms remain broker indications, and 3BR inventory is unresolved.

items.name: Reportage Abu Dhabi Fourth Corridor development
items.finding: 4 October Khaleej Times interview with Reportage managing director reports acquired approximately 750,000 sqm site and approximately 3,800 homes in design, probable market launch 2027/2028. Exact project name/plot, final unit mix and sales terms unknown.
items.nextCheck: Named scheme and plot-level identity; developer formal planning announcement

items.name: Janu Al Marjan Island
items.finding: 25 September Mansion Global feature republished Kanebridge 1 October reports late-October sales and USD2.3m starting indication; 6 October OffPlan Insider repeats that source rather than independently confirms. Official Janu page confirms 1–5BR homes and five villas but opening2028 conflicts with July Marjan2029 guidance. Do not claim fresh initial project or confirmed price/handover.
items.nextCheck: Dated official sales opening and price/SPA schedule
